evidence: Language and detailMode publish to independent strict versioned cells, structurally eliminating cross-field overwrite and all persistent lock lifecycle failure modes.
Sync initialization and async update reads use no-follow/nonblocking descriptors, maximum+1 bytes and both pre-read and post-read pathname identity checks.
Atomic temp files are mode 0600 and fsynced before rename; the private cell directory is mode 0700 and fsynced after publication; no post-rename pathname chmod follows a replacement.
Corrupt copies use only bytes captured from the diagnosed descriptor; parent, cell-directory and final-file symlinks fail closed without touching targets.
Production session start emits fixed bilingual corrupt/unavailable warnings and still invokes the bounded diagnostic callback.
Real concurrent child processes prove separate field cells survive and no shared lock artifact exists.
